Converting podcast or voiceover audio into video
Making faceless or talking head YouTube videos
Producing cinematic clips from images or ideas
summary.what_it_does: The page describes Mootion as an AI tool that creates videos from text, scripts, ideas, and images, with AI-generated visuals, synced audio, and scene-level control. It names an Audio-to-Video feature that turns existing audio recordings or voiceovers into video. It highlights character consistency as a capability in the title. The page is mostly marketing copy aimed at YouTubers, educators, and content creators, and it gives few concrete technical details beyond these features.
notable: Audio-to-Video feature for turning recordings or voiceovers into video
Scene-level control over AI visuals and synced audio
caveats: Pricing and plan details are not stated on the page
Page is mostly marketing; specific limits and capabilities are not documented
